text.en: Believing that solving the transformed algebraic equation for F(s) already answers the original problem — forgetting that F(s) lives in the frequency domain and still has to be transformed back with an inverse Laplace transform (typically via partial fractions and a lookup table) to get the actual time-domain solution f(t).
text.et: Arvamine, et teisendatud algebralise võrrandi lahendamine F(s) suhtes on juba algse ülesande vastus — unustades, et F(s) elab sagedustasandis ja tuleb veel pöördteisendusega (tavaliselt osamurdude ja tabeli abil) tagasi teisendada, et saada tegelik ajatasandi lahend f(t).
